display.fallback: Georgia, Source Serif 4, Noto Serif KR

chart.plot_area: 6.0in x 3.6in (left 6-7 of 12 cols), right 5-6 cols = takeaway text
chart.type_match: comparison=column, trend=line/column, share=donut(<=3)/100%-stacked, change=slope, composition=stacked(<=4 seg), relation=scatter
chart.value_label: 14pt Inter Semibold, tabular figures, on bar end / inside segment, highlight value #2563EB
chart.series_label: 13pt Inter #14213D direct at bar/line end (no legend box)
chart.line: 1.75pt solid, straight segments, primary #2563EB / secondary #14213D, markers 6px endpoints only, no area fill
chart.donut: <=3 segments, highlight #2563EB rest blue-ramp, center 42pt PT Serif key figure
chart.slope: two timepoints, value+series label at each end, highlight #2563EB 2pt rest #A8B4C6 1.25pt
chart.render: SVG precise, 0px corners, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no bevel/gloss/3D, no dual-axis
chart.title_rule: action title (conclusion sentence) is the chart title; no separate chart title

slide.action_title: conclusion sentence mandatory, not a label
slide.transition: cut | fade 0.2s | chart bar build L-to-R 0.3s
